body:
Hi @willjanning  — I investigated this in more depth and wrote up the full explanation here:

https://albertsugranyes.com/writing/iceberg-changelogs/

Short version: the behavior is explained by copy-on-write file rewrite boundaries and how changelog rows are associated with snapshot ownership, not by changelog computation itself. The post walks through two logically equivalent sequences that materialize different physical rewrites and therefore surface different changelog entries
